prompts.prompt: Production game sprite atlas, not a mockup. Use the approved concept for style only: exquisite rendered 3D porcelain chess figurines. Square transparent PNG, regular 4-column by 4-row grid of exactly 16 isolated full-body figures. No labels, UI, scenery, grid lines, floor, or outside cast shadows. Center each figure in its cell with 10% gutters, about 80% cell height and 65% width, bases aligned. Near-front camera with slightly visible tops, consistent upper-left soft light. Matte porcelain glaze, fine champagne gold, navy plinths. Recognizable chess-role heads on compact bodies, no human legs. Row 1: four pawns with round eyes and star badge, wink and crescent, closed eyes and heart, determined expression and lightning. Row 2: four pawns with spectacles and diamond, curious expression and clover, shy expression and sun, happy open mouth and leaf. Row 3: rook, knight, bishop, queen. Row 4: king, bishop, knight, rook; give paired roles distinct faces. Exactly eight pawns and eight back-rank figures. Finely modeled cheeks, eyes, bevels, collars, and highlights. True alpha transparency. Deep midnight navy #252a3a ceramic body and headgear, blue highlights, warm ivory faces, fine gold edges.
